tasks.title: E12 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E12 (Retrieval and typed tool gateway). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E12.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E12/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E12/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Freeze pure domain contracts and invariants
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md first, in that order, then every reads entry. This is an E12 coder brief, not authorization to change a provider or a shared file. Edit only owned_paths, including tests; do not add unlisted initializers. All implementation paths were absent at planning time. Recheck the current tree and all docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating anything. Existing work must be integrated with its owner, never overwritten or duplicated. Use E12 section 13's exact ownership and the rule trace in 1.1. SYSTEM 5.1 supplies IDs, 5.2/5.3 time and mission labels, 5.4 Quantity/UCUM, 5.5 typed errors and ErrorEnvelope, 5.6 validated release pins, 5.7 UOW/read snapshots/audiences, 5.8 target-and-body identity/receipts/current ResultVisibility, 5.9 append-only audit, 5.10/5.10.1 deadlines and staged tasks, 5.11 HubSettings, and 5.12 module registration. Do not implement substitutes. SYSTEM 6 supplies uv, generated contracts and import rules; 8.1/8.2/8.3 supplies evidence, guidance and field-level authorization; 9/10 supplies dependencies and kernel.testing. No git, product package edit, root project edit, local database/queue/cache, new API/event, UI code, runtime sample fallback or provider implementation. E12 owns no table or migration. Cross-module imports use application ports only; safety modules cannot import tools.

Before starting require the actual E01 kernel, generated effective models, hub/pyproject.toml, test configuration and import-contract generator. An unbuilt provider is represented only by its agreed Protocol and SYSTEM 10 kernel fakes at the declared port. Never invent a missing DTO or use a proposed request as a contract. R-E12-1/2/4/5/7/9/11/12 remain integration prerequisites until accepted and propagated. Return any new seam request to the supervisor/coordinator with exact evidence; do not edit requests. Safe unavailability is required but is not completed feature acceptance. No skip, xfail, empty selected suite or permissive fake can close that gap. No task creates another epic's code. Config content comes through versioned assistant-policy.json, ui-copy.json, indicator-catalog.json, questionnaires.json and owner releases as applicable, with provenance and last-good activation. Operational bounds are the exact E12 section 11 HubSettings, not domain configuration. No medical number, unit, label, medicine list or source is hardcoded. Use explicit fixture profiles; independent expected safety outcomes must not be calculated from the input configuration.

Write the stated regression/property/fault tests first, trace them to the existing T-E12 IDs plus their R/V/D or invariant, then implement the smallest code. Unit/integration tests are hermetic, bounded, and use injected clocks/IDs. Full-stack tests belong to T6 and use the real hub and SQLite, without mocks inside the hub. Run all owned gates; after a bug fix run the full hub suite as required by AGENTS. All commands run from the repository root. Explicit hub test/lint/type configuration settles review comment 2; the shared validator's E12 extension remains a T6 prerequisite. Report actual commands, results and blocked prerequisites. Done requires owned gates, evidence for each assigned proof and a typed handoff; whole-epic completion also requires T6, independent review, CI and coordinator-recorded AI-use rows. No em/en dashes or spaced hyphen used as a dash.

Build the pure typed boundary and invariants of E12 sections 2, 3/3.1, the domain parts of 4.4, 8 and 11. Own only the frozen values, port declarations, hard safety predicates, settings descriptors and common test scaffolding. T2 owns dispatch/effects, T3 retrieval execution and benchmark, T4 context assembly/provider reads, T5 shared-text policy orchestration, and T6 module wiring/e2e. Keep domain imports pure. Do not move application I/O into these values or add speculative abstractions.

Start only after R-E12-2/7/11/12 has supplied the complete agreed declarations needed here. E12 section 2 currently names several types without all fields: Phase, ContextBudget, TextField, TurnData, PolicyVerdict, AppliedEffects and HandlerOutcome. Obtain the approved declarations from the coordinator and E13/E17 before coding them; this brief does not invent their representation. Implement ToolScope, ToolCall, ToolResult, SupportItem, ContextSnapshot and PendingEffect from E12 3 and its accepted bindings. ToolResult has exactly tool_call_id, status, data, provenance_ids, observed_at, generated_at, limitations, error_code, with E12 3's complete internal status set. The closed public ModelAction union remains generated, including stop_incomplete. Use nullable fields as declared, never sentinel identifiers. Support flags separate finding, hypothesis and gap closure. Failed/rejected/uncertain/not_assessed/cancelled/declined attempts carry only metadata, never failed numbers; accepted conflicts keep both readings. Unknown freshness cannot authorize current support. Preserve observed-time corrections, source revisions, origin and UCUM. Required red flags, negatives and conflicts cannot be dropped to fit a budget.

Freeze application/ports.py declarations from E12 2: ToolGateway.execute(uow, scope, call) -> ToolResult; ContextBuilderPort.build(uow, scope, phase, budget) -> ContextSnapshot; OutputPolicyPort.check(fields, scope, turn) -> PolicyVerdict; EffectApplier.apply(uow, scope, effects, idempotency_prefix) -> AppliedEffects; ToolRegistry.register and handler; ToolHandler.handle(uow, scope, arguments, deadline) -> HandlerOutcome. Deadline aliases SYSTEM 5.10 ElapsedDeadline. Retain HandlerOk, HandlerNoResult, HandlerUnavailable and HandlerRejected only as settled by R-E12-2/12. Forward-referenced types must be actual agreed E12-owned values, not copies of providers. Put immutable shared values in the owned domain files according to their names, so downstream tasks do not need to edit them. The split between local preflight and external execution must be the accepted R-E12-12 binding, not a writer held across inference. Provider protocols are imported from their application ports or consumed through the agreed consumer protocol; never import their domain classes directly.

Enforce non-configurable domain prohibitions on assistant act/emergency, clearing/lowering rule or sensor warnings, acceptance of readings, dose computation and unauthorized scope. T5 invokes these pure checks alongside the canonical TextRulesPort; T1 does not write a text matcher. Domain retrieval/context modules define the immutable data/invariants used by T3/T4; those application services own the search and context algorithms. settings.py declares every tools.* setting exactly E12 11, including zero external_retries/private_cache_entries, finite bytes/count/depth/turn bounds, one active call and no waiting queue. Provider settings remain provider-owned. Registration is T6. Invalid descriptors fail optional gateway startup without disabling hub safety.

Tests first: test_scope.py proves I1/I2/I3/I4 and hard safety prohibitions for absent/foreign subject, incapable/absent operator, all origin modes and no widening by config; test_schema.py covers the pure T-E12-001/002 closed shapes, enums/nulls/IDs/body-region distinction and nonrecursive bounded inputs. test_support.py proves the pure T-E12-020/021/022/043 cases: accepted zero, failed values absent, retained disagreements, crewmate_palpation restrictions, habitat separated, all presence states and required-fact overflow. test_time.py proves T-E12-023 with clock corrections, stale/unknown/future time, restart epochs, mission boundaries and D14's limited replay exception. test_metrics.py supplies the unit/presence/domain-boundary portion of T-E12-024; it never implements a clinical formula. Positive calculation acceptance belongs to T4/T6 after E14's registry and independent golden cases exist. Property tests cover parsers and each pure safety decision. Common conftest/fakes reuse actual kernel.testing and fixed provider protocols; no fake shared mechanism. They must not import application services that later tasks have not implemented.

Fault boundary: these values create no accepted records. Missing/corrupt pins, unknown consent, partial/implausible/disagreeing quantities and clock uncertainty reject or remain unknown. T2/T6 exercise crash/disk/retry/concurrent writers; T6 exercises ground outage and incapacitated help. Done includes a concrete typed declaration handoff to T2 to T5, all immutable types available before their imports, owned tests green and no unresolved shape hidden behind Mapping, Any or a permissive schema.

Keep a missing handler visibly unavailable, but do not claim unfinished catalog/effect acceptance. ModelReleaseReader.tool_catalog(model_release_id) supplies closed schemas and exposure sets. Compile schemas at startup with bounded size and no remote references. ToolRegistry is static, bounded and rejects duplicate/unrecognized registrations; no dynamic import, reflection or executable configured name. Validate ToolCall through generated effective models and the pinned catalog. Do not add draft_insight or another stop action. The catalog's propose_measurement and the generated request_measurement ModelAction are mapped only by the accepted R-E12-2 mapping, never by a guessed alias.

Follow E12 4.1's exact order: current SessionContext, phase/static allowlist, total byte/depth/count/call budgets, closed argument parsing, every object/field grant, origin/pins, domain/output checks, bounded handler, support/result validation and committed safe audit before release. Consume invalid calls from the turn budget too; E13 allows at most one repair. Scope is injected and cannot be overwritten by arguments. ConsentQueries.allows(view, subject_person_id, recipient, scope) and RosterPort.members() are E02's exact section 2 seams with keyword arguments as declared. A model's forbidden reference returns MODEL_OUTPUT_REJECTED; user authentication/consent errors and storage/integrity failures retain SYSTEM 5.5 behavior. Audit only allowlisted references/codes, exactly once for each denial; audit failure cannot emit accepted text. Do not count a regex over IDs or roster names as public-query de-identification; R-E12-2 must settle that boundary before search is enabled.

EffectApplier runs only in the caller-owned E13 task-completion UOW, after live grants, source revisions, urgency, pins and generation are rechecked. Use SYSTEM 5.8 full actor/operation/target/parameters/body identity and durable original turn/call intent, not string-concatenated keys or a local ledger. E05 validates request reason, nonempty decision_affected, capability, source/subject/consent, body_region and current E11 RequestGatePort.check plus E27 kit eligibility. Missing decision_affected requires rejection/one repair, never copy reason or fabricate rationale. An unavailable kit commits the owner's unavailable MeasurementRequest plus CapabilityGap/form link and receipt/audit/events together, without acquisition. A rejected turn commits no proposal effect. E11 UrgencyCommands.request_review_from_model(uow, ctx) may propose review, never disposition urgency. Gap, handoff and guided-check drafts use E05/E16/E30 only after their accepted same-UOW bindings; no send, approval, assignment, device start or accepted Observation. All provider effects, result, receipt, audit/outbox, replication and follow-up tasks join the existing shared commit. E12 emits no C18 event itself. Wire operations stay with E13: openConversation, sendMessage, streamConversation, cancelTurn, startAssessment, getAssessment (E12 6).

Tests first: test_gateway.py covers T-E12-001/002/003/004/006/008/015 and R17/R28/V25: unknown/out-of-stage tool, literal-query versus executable-query boundary, malformed/nested schema, cross-patient even with claimed officer/helper authority, owner independently refusing when gateway precheck is removed, configured question text/choices only, no unsafe registry entry and sanitized audit/errors. test_bounds.py covers T-E12-005/067, zero/negative/empty/max/overflow, invalid-call budgets, every E12 11 descriptor and bounded startup parsing; setting edits change bounds without changing safety mappings. test_effects.py covers T-E12-011/013/014: available and unavailable requests (R45,D06,D30,V78), every preflight/execute/apply/commit/ACK failure boundary, disk full, locked/corrupt storage, cancelled/expired generations, concurrent answers/kit/grants, retry after cache expiry and changed-target conflict. Use the actual shared SQLite/UOW implementation for durability tests once available, never implement a test-only transaction manager. Provider protocol fakes in local tests do not close T6's real-effect acceptance. Record correction must invalidate staging, not silently rebase it (V30). Ground absence cannot be an authorization or commit dependency; an incapacitated person does not imply consent. Done includes exact receipt and no-duplicate-effect evidence plus handoff of static handler factories for T6. These tests supplement, and do not replace, review comment 1's full HTTP scenarios in T6.

Build pinned evidence retrieval and its development comparison, E12 sections 4.2, 5, 8/8.1 and 11. T1 owns the frozen retrieval values/ports, T2 dispatch, T4 context selection, T5 publication policy, T6 assembly/e2e. No E10 index, E17 model runtime/artifact loader, E18 corpus/evaluator or new retrieval API is created. Preconditions: actual E10/E27 agreed protocols, R-E12-1 citation representation, R-E12-2 public-query boundary and R-E12-12 snapshot/external-execute/tokenizer/reranker permit binding. R-E12-5 supplies required notices. An unavailable binding must stay unavailable; a made-up tokenizer or byte estimate cannot close the task.

Copy EvidenceQueryPort signatures from E10 4.1: lexical_search(release_id, query, use, filters, mode, k), dense_search with the same release/query/use/filters/k, expand_context(release_id, passage_id, use, filters, neighbors), read_approved(release_id, passage_id, use), inspect_history(passage_id, cursor, limit) and discrepancies. Use its declared parameter kinds and return unions exactly. AllowedUse is the effective generated enum; SearchMode exact/stemmed. Bind reads to the same snapshot and explicit evidence release. ConditionRegistryPort.condition_status/aliases preserves source versions. GuidanceEligibility.evaluate(snapshot, request) is SYSTEM 8.2; unknown purpose/source/origin/environment/operator/resources cannot authorize guidance. Q1/Q18's eligible not_clinically_reviewed label never relaxes source approval, withdrawal, rights or purpose. Q2 metadata-only sources supply no text/vector. Never call active_release as a substitute for a missing pin.

Implement exact/stemmed/optional dense reciprocal-rank fusion in retrieval_service.py, with rank starting at one, sum 1/(k_rrf+rank), passage-ID tie order and no confidence interpretation. E17 ModelReleaseReader.retrieval_settings owns k_rrf and tuning; E12 section 11 only caps work. Deduplicate candidates, retain discrepancy metadata and contradictory versions without using history as current support. E10's typed IndexUnavailable for dense permits lexical fallback and the validated notice; storage/integrity/config/auth failures are not empty success. Optional reranking only reorders eligible candidates with pinned artifacts and permit outside writer UOWs. Missing reranker is visible. Expand only through E10, recheck each neighbor's eligibility and exact citation, and preserve whole table units within combined count/byte/token bounds. A valid empty eligible search is no_result; failure to search is unavailable/error. E13 owns semantic claim entailment and final citation publication.

The token_counter adapter consumes the exact E17 tokenizer/template serialization binding, including wrappers, special tokens and output reserve. No byte fallback, unpinned tokenizer, second heavy model or unbounded token allocation. T4 gets this behavior via T1's agreed contract, never by importing the adapter into domain code. Handle corrupt/missing artifacts and cancellation without long writer transactions.

Settle review comment 3 here. cli_bench consumes only E18 section 2's dev *.case.json files and retrieval/*.labels.json rows {query_case_id, relevant_passage_ids, no_answer}, under the provider's verified partition/frozen manifest contract (E18 3.4/4.3). fixtures/tools/manifest.json records the allowlisted paths/hashes using that existing format; do not create a parallel label schema or publish an E18 gate score. Require dev identity from E18, resolved containment and hashes; deny symlink escape, traversal and adjacent holdout. No clinical process receives a file/vault port. source-checklist.json records independently checked source references and expected support/eligibility cases, not expectations derived from the same release under test. Fixtures are explicit eval inputs; missing provider manifests are a prerequisite, not sample fallback.

Freeze one query population for all methods before running. Relevant passage IDs are unique binary relevance labels. Reject duplicate case IDs, no_answer inconsistent with relevant IDs, references outside the pinned corpus and malformed/missing labels before scoring. Deduplicate returned IDs preserving their earliest rank. Recall uses E18's |relevant intersect unique top k|/|relevant| over answerable cases. nDCG uses binary gain, discount 1/log2(rank+1), and an ideal list of min(k, relevant count) relevant IDs.
